description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigFileAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically handling API requests related to configuration file operations during installer/upgrader processes. The class extends an abstract REST controller and manages actions such as writing configuration files, sending registration data, and validating database connection status during system setup.

classes.name: ConfigFileAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing configuration files during the system upgrade process, including writing configuration files and handling registration data sending.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST HTTP requests to generate configuration files and verify database connection status, and initiates registration data transmission if applicable.

methods.name: sendRegistrationData
methods.description: Prepares and sends registration data to a remote server, logs registration events, and manages registration state.

methods.name: getRegistrationType
methods.description: Returns the registration type identifier used during registration event recording.
